_README.about: TEST FIXTURE. Deterministic test cases for run_code, keyed by exercise id. Each entry is {contract, tests:[{name, stdin, expected, match?}]}; 'match' is 'exact' (whitespace-normalised, default) or 'contains'.

AST101-L01-celestial-sphere-code.contract: Read two integers a and b from stdin (whitespace separated); print their sum on one line.

AST101-L04-inverse-square-law-code.contract: Read a positive integer k from stdin; print k*k on one line.
